Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.olga

package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.olga
OLGA GENKEY export package for field development.

This package turns already-validated NeqSim reservoir inflow and wellbore-trajectory data into text an OLGA transient multiphase flow simulator can read directly, as part of a GENKEY input case.

Key Classes

  • OlgaWellGenkeyExporter - Exports a well's liquid inflow performance relationship and trajectory as OLGA GENKEY text (a case-level TABULAR keyword plus a well network-component block).
  • SyntheticWellTrajectory - Generates a synthetic (MD, TVD) wellbore deviation trajectory for use when no real survey exists, interpolated from a caller-supplied depth-tier statistics basis (this package ships no embedded well/field data of its own).

Scope

This package deliberately exports only what its real inputs (the inflow relationship and the trajectory) determine: a TABULAR inflow-performance table, GEOMETRY, PIPE segments, HEATTRANSFER (a required, caller-supplied lumped coefficient, never a fabricated default), and RESERVOIRCONTACT. It never emits a layered WALL/MATERIAL conduction model (optional per OLGA's own bundled reference cases, and would require real conductivity/capacity/density data this package has no way to know), a case-level PVTFILE=/FLUID= reference (the PVT file is declared once per case, not duplicated per well), a choke valve, or segment grading -- see OlgaWellGenkeyExporter's own "Deliberately out of scope" Javadoc section for the reasoning behind each. Embed the exported text inside a full genkey case built by the caller.

  • Class
    Description
    OlgaWellGenkeyExporter
    Exports a well's liquid inflow performance relationship and trajectory as OLGA GENKEY text: case-level MATERIAL/WALL/TABULAR library keywords followed by a NETWORKCOMPONENT TYPE=FLOWPATH well network-component block, ready to embed inside a full genkey case.
    SyntheticWellTrajectory
    Generates a synthetic (not a specific well's real) wellbore deviation trajectory -- (MD, TVD) station arrays -- for use when no real Prosper model, SMDA record, or other real trajectory source exists for a well, interpolated from a caller-supplied, depth-dependent statistics basis rather than a single generic textbook default or a bare vertical pipe.
    SyntheticWellTrajectory.DepthTier
    One depth tier's own mean statistics, supplied by the caller (see this class's own "Data governance" Javadoc).
    SyntheticWellTrajectory.Result
    The generated trajectory and everything a caller needs to interpret or disclose it.
    SyntheticWellTrajectory.Statistics
    A depth-tier statistics basis -- the depth tiers, default max inclination, and a human-readable provenance description together, mirroring the ported Python module's own statistics= parameter (an already-loaded statistics dict).
    SyntheticWellTrajectory.SyntheticTrajectoryException
    Raised for a caller input this class refuses to build a trajectory from (e.g. a non-positive target depth), as opposed to a condition that is handled with a documented fallback and a warning.
    SyntheticWellTrajectory.TierInterpolation
    The specific interpolated build rate/KOP/max-inclination values a SyntheticWellTrajectory.Result actually used.
